name: scavio
description: Live web, social media, retailer and real estate data: Google Search, News, Shopping, Maps, Flights, Hotels, Trends, Google Play and Ads Transparency; 40 US retailers including Amazon, Walmart, Target, Costco, Home Depot and Best Buy; TikTok, YouTube and Instagram; Zillow, Redfin and Realtor.com; published company contact details; and the content of any public web page or site.

interface.longDescription:
Scavio brings live web, social media, retailer and real estate data into your conversations.

What you can do:
- Google: search Google and get the full results page, including related questions and local results; find recent news; compare products and sellers on Google Shopping; find businesses, places and reviews on Google Maps; search Google Flights and Google Hotels; check Google Trends and what is trending now; look up apps on Google Play and ads in the Google Ads Transparency Center.
- US retailers: search products and read prices, sale and clearance prices, ratings, reviews, sellers, deals and store stock at Amazon, Walmart, Target, Costco, Home Depot, Lowe's, Best Buy, eBay, Kroger, Sam's Club, CVS, Walgreens, Whole Foods Market, H-E-B, Publix, ALDI, Dollar General, Sephora, Ulta Beauty, Macy's, Nordstrom, Nordstrom Rack, Kohl's, JCPenney, Saks Fifth Avenue, Dick's Sporting Goods, Foot Locker, Fanatics, Chewy, PetSmart, Petco, iHerb, Menards, Harbor Freight, Micro Center, Wayfair, Ashley Furniture, TCGplayer, Mercari and Spec's.
- Social media: look up public TikTok, YouTube and Instagram content, including videos, posts, comments, creators, hashtags, sounds and video transcripts.
- Real estate: search homes for sale, for rent and recently sold on Zillow, Redfin and Realtor.com, with property details, price and tax history, value estimates, market stats and agents.
- Look up a company's published emails, phone numbers and social profiles from its own website.
- Read any public web page, list the pages of a site, or read many pages at once.

Who it is for: anyone researching a topic, a market, a product, a price, a creator, a property or a list of local businesses who needs current information with links to the sources.

How it works: sign in with your Scavio account when you connect. Requests run on that account.

Limitations: Scavio reads public content only. It cannot sign in to other websites, read private accounts or messages, post, or buy anything. Prices and stock are as shown when you ask. Site crawls respect robots.txt, and crawl and batch results stay available for 3 days.
capabilities: Search Google, News, Shopping and Maps
Search Google Flights, Hotels and Trends
Compare prices, deals, reviews and store stock at 40 US retailers
Look up public TikTok, YouTube and Instagram content
Search homes, property details and market stats on Zillow, Redfin and Realtor.com
defaultPrompt: Compare air fryer prices at Walmart, Target and Amazon.
Find five highly rated bakeries in Chicago on Google Maps with their phone numbers.
Show three-bedroom homes for sale in Austin, TX under $500,000.

positive.prompt: Search Google for the best project management tools for small teams and list the top five results with links.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_google once and lists five organic results, each with its title and link, taken from the returned results page.

positive.prompt: Find highly rated coffee shops in Austin, Texas on Google Maps, list five with rating and address, then show three reviews for the first one.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls google_maps_search, lists five places with rating and address, then calls google_maps_reviews with the first place's place_id and shows three of its reviews.

positive.prompt: Search Walmart for air fryers and list the top three results with price and rating.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_walmart and lists the top three products with title, price and rating from the returned data, with links.

positive.prompt: Search TikTok for videos about sourdough starter tips and list five with the creator and view count.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_tiktok_videos and lists five videos with caption, creator and view count from the returned results.

positive.prompt: Search Realtor.com for three-bedroom homes for sale in Austin, TX under $500,000 and list three with price and address.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_realtor for Austin, TX with the bedroom and price filters and lists three listings with price and address from the returned results.

review.commerce_description: Scavio does not sell products or process payments through this plugin. It returns public web data, including product prices, for information only.

publication.release_notes: Adds every Google product Scavio covers (Shopping product details, Flights, Hotels, Trends, Google Play, Ads Transparency), 40 US retailers, TikTok, YouTube and Instagram, and Zillow, Redfin and Realtor.com, with a skill for each.
